item.title: Time and Space Complexity
item.description: Time and Space Complexity When analyzing an algorithm, we care about how efficient it is. Two main measures are: Type What It Measures Goal Time Complexity How long the algorithm takes (number of operations as input grows). Make it as fast as possible. Space Complexity How much memory it uses (extra variables, data structures, recursion stack, etc.). Make it as memory-efficient as possible. Big-O Notation Big-O notation describes how fast the runtime grows as the input size grows.
